items.title: Inspecteur Gadget : Affaire inclassable / Inspector Gadget's Last Case (2002) - VFF/French/Français
items.description: <div>In 2002, as part of the DIC Movie Toons series of movies, DIC released a full-length animated television film called Inspector Gadget's Last Case, directed by Michael Maliani. It premiered on television on October 6, 2002, on Nickelodeon and was released on DVD and VHS shortly afterward by MGM
